label: Attio
description: Customizable real-time CRM for tracking people, companies, deals, lists, notes, and tasks.
notes: Record/list-entry attribute writes and filtered searches need the piece runtime (attribute-type formatting into typed JSON objects, pagination, member normalization). getRecord returns raw attribute values without the piece's workspace-member normalization pass. createTask is simplified to content-only: deadline_at/is_completed/linked_records/assignees are hardcoded to null/false/[]/[] because the API requires typed JSON values templates cannot emit. listTasks fetches a single page (limit=500) with no filters since Attio rejects empty-string query filters. createListEntry sends entry_values as a hardcoded empty object; list attribute values require the piece runtime.

nodes.label: Attio: Get Record
nodes.description: Fetch a single Attio record by object type and record ID.
nodes.search: attio crm get record fetch person company deal lookup retrieve

config.label: Object
config.help: Object API slug or ID (e.g. people, companies, deals)

config.label: Record ID
config.help: UUID of the record to retrieve

credentials.help: Workspace access token: Attio → Workspace settings → Developers → New Access Token, with record read scopes

nodes.label: Attio: Create Note
nodes.description: Attach a plaintext or markdown note to an Attio record.
nodes.search: attio crm note create add comment annotation record person company

config.label: Parent Object
config.help: Object API slug or ID of the record's type

config.label: Parent Record ID
config.help: UUID of the record to attach the note to

config.label: Format
config.help: How the note content is interpreted

credentials.help: Workspace access token: Attio → Workspace settings → Developers → New Access Token, with note write scope

nodes.label: Attio: Create Task

credentials.help: Workspace access token: Attio → Workspace settings → Developers → New Access Token, with task write scope
